pages.https://www.acmepay.com/about:
# About Acme

Our mission is to make getting paid boring, so small stores can focus on what they sell.

Founded in 2019 in Austin, Acme now has about 400 people across the US and Europe.

## What we value

- **Default to clarity.** Write it down, keep it short.
- **Small teams, big ownership.** Every team owns a problem end to end.
- **Merchants first.** If it doesn't help a store get paid, we don't build it.
